image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured, hairy girdle. The background consists of encrusted rock with pink coralline algae.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anterior end of the chiton is visible and blunt; there are no protruding eyes or tentacles, consistent with chiton anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front of the animal tapers smoothly into the first plate without distinct head features.
No antennae or sensory organs are visible on the dorsal surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dorsal surface protected by eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in linear series.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Exactly eight distinct, overlapping plates are clearly visible running from head to tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plates embedded in tough leathery girdle that may be smooth, spiny, or hairy.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates are surrounded by a thick, textured mantle (girdle) that appears to have fine hairs or spines (aesthetes).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates exhibit a mottled greyish-brown coloration with lighter speckling, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface features broad muscular foot for adhesion to rocky substrates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a dorsal view; the ventral foot is completely occluded by the body and substrate contact.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The organism conforms tightly to the irregular rock surface, indicating a flattened profile adapted for adhesion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Can curl into defensive ball when dislodged.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral capability, not a static visual feature observable in this specific pose.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic identity of the mollusk and distinguish it from similar-looking armored organisms.
To verify the structural integrity of the eight plates and ensure the girdle merges naturally with the plates without AI melting artifacts.
To assess the texture realism of the 'hairy' girdle and the mineral details of the plates, checking for common AI texture smearing.
To ensure the chiton sits correctly on the rock surface with proper occlusion and shadowing, avoiding floating effects.

Texture consistency of the girdle (hairy/spiny appearance)
Boundary sharpness between plates and girdle
